title: Sheikh-Anas-Tauseef/rag-pdf-chatbot
description: A conversational QA bot that answers questions from PDF documents using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline — built with LangChain, Groq LLM API, ChromaDB, HuggingFace embeddings, and a Gradio interface. Supports multi-PDF upload and remembers chat history for follow-up questions.
